products.name: Blueberries, fresh
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole blueberries only; no syrup, sugar, or coating. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash before serving.
products.selectionGuide: Choose dry, plump berries; check the bottom of the punnet for crushed or mouldy fruit.

products.name: Raspberries, fresh
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole raspberries only; no sweetener or coating. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; handle gently and wash as needed.
products.selectionGuide: Choose dry berries that hold their shape, with no juice pooling or mould in the punnet.

products.name: Strawberries, fresh
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole strawberries only; no added sugar or glaze. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; remove damaged berries and wash.
products.selectionGuide: Look for dry, firm berries with fresh green tops and no soft or mouldy spots.

products.name: Blackberries, fresh
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole blackberries only; no sweetener or coating. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash before serving.
products.selectionGuide: Choose plump, dark berries that are dry and intact, with no mould or leaking juice.

products.name: Lingonberries, fresh
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole lingonberries only; avoid sweetened sauce or jam. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash before serving.
products.selectionGuide: Choose firm, bright berries with no shrivelled or mouldy fruit; fresh stock may be seasonal.

products.name: Red currants, fresh
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole red currants only; no added sugar. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash before serving.
products.selectionGuide: Choose firm, bright clusters with intact stems and no mould or crushed berries.

products.name: Black currants, fresh
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole black currants only; no added sugar. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash before serving.
products.selectionGuide: Choose plump, dark berries without shrivelling, mould, or wet patches.

products.name: Gooseberries, fresh
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole gooseberries only; no syrup or added sugar. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash before serving.
products.selectionGuide: Choose firm berries with unbroken skins; avoid soft, leaking, or mouldy ones.

products.name: Blueberries, frozen
products.ingredientsCriteria: Blueberries as the only ingredient; no sweetener. Processing check: Frozen whole fruit; check that no sugar or sauce is added.
products.selectionGuide: Choose a sealed bag with loose berries rather than one frozen into a solid lump.

products.name: Raspberries, frozen
products.ingredientsCriteria: Raspberries as the only ingredient; no sweetener. Processing check: Frozen whole fruit; check that no sugar or sauce is added.
products.selectionGuide: Choose a sealed, undamaged bag with berries mostly separate, not thawed and refrozen.

products.name: Strawberries, frozen
products.ingredientsCriteria: Strawberries as the only ingredient; no sweetener. Processing check: Frozen whole fruit; check that no sugar or sauce is added.
products.selectionGuide: Choose a sealed bag with intact frozen berries and no signs of thawing.

products.name: Mixed forest berries, frozen
products.ingredientsCriteria: A mix of whole berries only; no added sugar or flavouring. Processing check: Frozen fruit mix; check the ingredient list and avoid sweetened mixes.
products.selectionGuide: Choose a sealed bag with loose frozen berries and a clear berry-only ingredient list.

products.name: Black currants, frozen
products.ingredientsCriteria: Black currants as the only ingredient; no sweetener. Processing check: Frozen whole fruit; check that no sugar or sauce is added.
products.selectionGuide: Choose a sealed bag with berries loose inside and no thawing damage.

products.name: Apples
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole apples; choose the variety and size Anna approves. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash before eating.
products.selectionGuide: Choose firm apples with smooth skins and no bruises or soft spots; select a ripe-to-eat firmness you prefer.

products.name: Pears
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole pears; avoid bruised or leaking fruit. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash before eating.
products.selectionGuide: Choose intact pears; a slight give near the stem indicates ripeness, while mushy areas mean overripe.

products.name: Bananas
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole bananas; no coating or sweetened preparation. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; peel before eating.
products.selectionGuide: Choose the ripeness you need: green for later, yellow for soon; avoid split skins or bruising.

products.name: Oranges
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole oranges; avoid waxed or prepared fruit if the package adds ingredients. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash the peel before cutting.
products.selectionGuide: Choose firm oranges that feel heavy for their size, with no soft or mouldy areas.

products.name: Clementines
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole clementines; no syrup or added sugar. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash before peeling.
products.selectionGuide: Choose firm, heavy fruit with smooth skins and no soft patches or mould.

products.name: Lemons
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole lemons; no preserved or sweetened preparation. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash the peel before use.
products.selectionGuide: Choose firm lemons that feel heavy for their size, with bright intact skins and no soft spots.

products.name: Kiwifruit
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole kiwifruit; no sweetened or dried preparation. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash before cutting.
products.selectionGuide: Choose unbruised fruit; a gentle give means ready to eat, while firm fruit can ripen at home.

products.name: Avocados
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole avocados; no pre-seasoned or dressed preparation. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash the skin before cutting.
products.selectionGuide: Choose according to timing: firm for later or gently yielding for today; avoid sunken, very soft, or cracked spots.

products.name: Grapes
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole grapes; no coating or sweetened preparation. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash before eating.
products.selectionGuide: Choose firm grapes attached to fresh-looking stems; avoid leaking, shrivelled, or mouldy clusters.

products.name: Plums
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole plums; no syrup or added sugar. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash before eating.
products.selectionGuide: Choose intact plums with natural bloom and slight give when ripe; avoid split or very soft fruit.

products.name: Peaches or nectarines
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole peaches or nectarines; no syrup or glaze. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash before eating.
products.selectionGuide: Choose fragrant fruit with unbroken skin and a slight give; avoid bruises and leaking areas.

products.name: Melon
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole melon; avoid cut pieces stored warm or with added syrup. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash rind before cutting.
products.selectionGuide: Choose an intact melon that feels heavy for its size; check for a fresh smell near the stem and no soft patches.

products.name: Pineapple
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole pineapple; no syrup or added sugar. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash the rind before cutting.

products.name: Pomegranate
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole pomegranate; avoid sweetened juice or prepared seeds with additives. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash the outside before opening.
products.selectionGuide: Choose a heavy fruit with firm, unbroken skin and no soft or mouldy patches.

products.name: Mango
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole mango; no syrup or sweetened preparation. Processing check: Fresh whole fruit; wash the skin before cutting.
products.selectionGuide: Choose intact fruit that gives slightly when gently pressed; colour alone does not determine ripeness.

products.name: Carrots
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole carrots; loose or simply bagged, without dip or glaze. Processing check: Fresh whole vegetable; wash or peel as preferred.
products.selectionGuide: Choose firm, smooth carrots without cracks, limpness, or soft dark areas.

products.name: Broccoli
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole broccoli; no sauce or seasoning. Processing check: Fresh whole vegetable; wash before cooking.
products.selectionGuide: Choose tight, dark green florets and a firm stem; avoid yellowing or slimy areas.

products.name: Cauliflower
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole cauliflower; no sauce or seasoning. Processing check: Fresh whole vegetable; wash before cooking.

products.name: Red cabbage
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole red cabbage; avoid prepared salad with dressing. Processing check: Fresh whole vegetable; wash outer leaves before cutting.
products.selectionGuide: Choose a dense, heavy head with crisp outer leaves and no soft spots.

products.name: Savoy cabbage
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole savoy cabbage; no seasoning or sauce. Processing check: Fresh whole vegetable; wash leaves before use.

products.name: Kale
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole kale leaves; no sauce or seasoning. Processing check: Fresh whole vegetable; wash thoroughly before use.
products.selectionGuide: Choose crisp, deep green leaves without yellowing, sliminess, or extensive holes.

products.name: Spinach

products.selectionGuide: Choose crisp green leaves with no sliminess or yellowing; check bagged leaves for condensation.

products.name: Romaine lettuce
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole lettuce; no prepared dressing or toppings. Processing check: Fresh whole vegetable; wash leaves before eating.

products.name: Tomatoes
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole tomatoes; no sauce or seasoning. Processing check: Fresh whole vegetable; wash before eating.

products.name: Red bell peppers
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole peppers; no stuffing, sauce, or seasoning. Processing check: Fresh whole vegetable; wash before cutting.

products.name: Cucumber
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole cucumber; avoid pickled or dressed versions for this item. Processing check: Fresh whole vegetable; wash before slicing.
products.selectionGuide: Choose a firm cucumber with even colour and no soft ends, wrinkles, or cuts.

products.name: Zucchini
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole zucchini; no sauce or seasoning. Processing check: Fresh whole vegetable; wash before cooking.
products.selectionGuide: Choose a firm, smaller-to-medium zucchini with smooth skin and no soft bruises.

products.name: Aubergine
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole aubergine; no prepared dip or seasoning. Processing check: Fresh whole vegetable; wash before cooking.
products.selectionGuide: Choose a firm, glossy aubergine with taut skin and a fresh green cap; avoid dents or soft spots.

products.name: Sweet potatoes
products.ingredientsCriteria: Whole sweet potatoes; no glaze or seasoning. Processing check: Fresh whole vegetable; scrub before cooking.

products.name: Potatoes

products.name: Beetroot

products.name: Parsnips

products.name: Yellow onions

products.name: Leeks

products.name: Celery stalks

products.name: Asparagus

products.name: Brussels sprouts

products.name: Radishes

products.name: Pumpkin

products.name: Cannellini beans, canned
products.ingredientsCriteria: Cannellini beans, water, and optionally salt; no sauce or seasoning. Processing check: Simply canned legume; check for added ingredients.

products.name: Yellow split peas, dried

products.name: Silken tofu, plain

products.name: Mung beans, dried

products.name: Ground flaxseed

products.name: Pumpkin seeds, unsalted
